2438-7084-8293.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Cleveland Booker triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

2292-2317-6664-7084.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat.

1417-2842-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1417-2842-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Blood Artist, Bridge from Below and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bridge from Below ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Blood Artist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2281-6132-6495.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Saffi triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
2281-6132-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

586-864-3125-5147-5632.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-5147-5632.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Chalk Outline.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Chalk Outline trigger, creating a creature token and Clue token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Bellowing Aegisaur

1617-4831-4983-5358-7936.easyPrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {G}.
1617-4831-4983-5358-7936.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wayta by paying {G} and tapping it, causing Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur to fight each other, with each only taking 1 damage due to Temple Altisaur.
Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur trigger twice.
Resolve both Bellowing Aegisaur triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Resolve both Cacophodon triggers, untapping the mana-producing permanent and Wayta.
Repeat from step 2, alternating between having Cacophodon fight Bellowing Aegisaur and Dominion Saboteur to ensure neither dies due to lethal damage.

4067-5742-5743-7824.description:
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

394-2034-3240-6462.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating a Treasure token and creature token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

643-3967-4302.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
643-3967-4302.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Maskwood Nexus, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2528-2921-5088-7443-7537.notablePrerequisites:
You control eight or more lands.
Any one opponent cannot block and kill Emeritus of Abundance this turn.
2528-2921-5088-7443-7537.description:
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting any card besides the actual Regrowth.
Pyromancer's Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning that card from your graveyard to your hand.
Declare Emeritus of Abundance as an attacker.
When Emeritus of Abundance attacks, it triggers, becoming prepared.
During your second main phase, cast a copy of Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, targeting the actual Regrowth card.
Pyromancer Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning Regrowth from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Channel the Suns by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Channel the Suns.
Resolve both copies of Channel the Suns, adding mana.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Emeritus of Abundance, producing that card's result.
Cast the card Regrowth from your hand by paying {1}{G}, targeting Emeritus of Abundance.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Regrowth and allowing you to target Channel the Suns with the copy.
Resolve both copies of Regrowth, returning Emeritus of Abundance and Channel the Suns from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Channel the Suns by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Channel the Suns.
Resolve both copies of Channel the Suns, adding mana.
Cast Emeritus of Abundance by paying {2}{G}.
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting Channel the Suns.
Both of Pyromancer Ascension's abilities trigger.
In response, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Emeritus of Ideation, producing that card's result.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's first abiliity, putting a redundant quest counter on it if desired.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's second ability, copying Regrowth and targeting Emeritus of Abundance with the copy.
Repeat from step 15.

2239-4872-5144.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Ardent Elementalist and exiling Ephemerate.
When Ardent Elementalist enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Ardent Elementalist.
When Ardent Elementalist enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

650-2511-3175.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

3110-3532-5078-7328.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3110-3532-5078-7328.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Donatello triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Donatello.
Repeat.

1651-4259-4508-6428.notablePrerequisites: You have three or more opponents.
1651-4259-4508-6428.description:
Activate Collector's Vault by paying {2} and tapping it, causing you to loot and create a Treasure token.
Magmakin Artillerist triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Treasures, untapping Collector's Vault.
Repeat.
1651-4259-4508-6428.notes: The combo fails to sustain itself once you have fewer than three opponents remaining and/or your library is empty.

643-3967-5310-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
643-3967-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

343-1753-2366-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
343-1753-2366-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Regal Behemoth triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

562-7070--141.easyPrerequisites: You are able to reduce the affinity creature's cost by {2} or more.
562-7070--141.description:
Activate Warrior en-Kor's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting the affinity creature.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Warrior en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to its affinity ability.
Repeat.
562-7070--141.notes: You want to reduce the affinity creature's cost by {2} or more using its affinity ability. For example, if you choose Ancestral Statue, you need to control two or more attacking creatures.

4336-5147-5220-6900.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

1350-2793-5686-6871.description:
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
At the beginning of your end step, Toph triggers, causing Ugin's Nexus to become an artifact land creature.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus. Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Toph triggers, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Ugin's Nexus from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-889-1387-1500-3940.description:
Cast Haze of Rage with buyback by paying {R}. Birgi, Haze of Rage's storm ability, Blood Funnel and Deekah trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Deekah trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Blood Funnel trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature token.
Resolve the Haze of Rage trigger, creating a copy of it for each spell cast before it this turn.
If you created copies of Haze of Rage this way, Deekah triggers for each copy, creating that many creature tokens.
Resolve all Haze of Rage spells.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent

1745-4567.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 22 minus Greven's power.
1745-4567.description:
Activate Lord of the Forsaken by paying 1 life.
Repeat step 1 until Greven has power 21 or greater due to its first ability.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Greven. The opponent loses the game due to being dealt 21 or more combat damage from your commander.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more charge counters on it

3609-6657.description:
Activate Magistrate Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it.
Holding priority, activate Gogo by paying {6} and tapping it, copying Magistrate Scepter's ability three times.
Resolve all Magistrate Scepter abilities, causing you to take four extra turns after this one.
Move to your first extra turn.
Activate Magistrate Scepter's first ability by paying {4} and tapping it, putting a charge counter on it.
Repeat steps 4 and 5 during your second and third extra turns.
Repeat from step 1 during your fourth extra turn.

1371-1605-3432-6500.easyPrerequisites:
There is a land on the battlefield.
Each opponent has 40 or less life.
1371-1605-3432-6500.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Tephraderm indestructible.
1371-1605-3432-6500.description:
Give Tephraderm indestructible, if needed.
Cast Star of Extinction by paying {5}{R}{R}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to copy Star of Extinction.
Resolve an opponent's Star of Extinction, destroying a land and dealing 20 damage to each creature and planeswalker.
Tephraderm's second ability triggers, dealing 40 damage to the opponent who controlled the Star of Extinction copy due to Gratuitous Violence.
Repeat from step 4 for each remaining Star of Extinction until each opponent loses the game.
1371-1605-3432-6500.notes: If an opponent survives the loop, you will lose the game if you have 40 or less life once your own Star of Extinction resolves.

1336-2816.easyPrerequisites: Umbral Mantle attached to Heronblade Elite.
1336-2816.notablePrerequisites: Heronblade Elite does not have summoning sickness, and has power 3 or greater.
1336-2816.description:
Activate Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Heronblade Elite by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2034-4826-6188-6332--85.notablePrerequisites:
Fear of Missing Out cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2034-4826-6188-6332--85.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Terra's first ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards.
Declare Terra and Fear of Missing Out as attackers.
Fear of Missing Out triggers, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Terra, triggering its second ability.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Fear of Missing Out, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Terra ability, choosing to pay {2} to trigger its reflexive ability, returning Fear of Missing Out from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When Fear of Missing Out enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to rummage.
Repeat each combat phase.

2921-5361-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
Auton Soldier on the battlefield as a copy of Lonis.
2921-5361-5365.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and Auton Soldier's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Auton Soldier.
Auton Soldier's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.
2921-5361-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

864-2438-2639-3254-4871.manaNeeded: {4}{G/W}{B}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
864-2438-2639-3254-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one non-Human creature.
864-2438-2639-3254-4871.description:
Cast Nethroi either from your hand or from the command zone for its mutate cost by paying {4}{G/W}{B}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable, putting it on top of a non-Human creature you control.
When Nethroi enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Nethroi.
When Nethroi dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Nethroi trigger from step 2, returning Eternal Witness and Mitotic Slime from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Nethroi from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing Eternal Witness and Mitotic Slime.
When Eternal Witness and Mitotic Slime die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice and Mitotic Slime triggers once.
Resolve both Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Mitotic Slime trigger, creating two 2/2 Ooze creature tokens.
Resolve both Carrion Feeder abilities, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing two Oozes.
When the Oozes die, they each trigger and Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice.
Resolve both Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve both Ooze triggers, creating four 1/1 Ooze creature tokens.
Resolve both Carrion Feeder abilities, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing two Oozes.
When the Oozes die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve both Carrion Feeder abilities, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate the seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{G/W}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

142-2781.notablePrerequisites: Saheeli Rai has at least three loyalty counters on it.
142-2781.description:
Activate Saheeli Rai's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, creating a token copy of Felidar Guardian that is an artifact in addition to its other types and has haste.
The Felidar Guardian token enters the battlefield, blinking Saheeli Rai.
Repeat.
